name: omniread
description: Bilingual PDF reader with DeepSeek AI sentence-level translation and interactive side-by-side reading

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.start: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run python -m tests.smoke_test
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
